# Public Claims Reconciliation

**Generated:** 2026-04-26  
**Task:** Rehaul Phase 0 — Inventory & Public-Claims Reconciliation  
**Inventory source:** `audit/runtime/project-inventory.json` (generated by `scripts/inventory/generate-inventory.js`)

---

## Methodology

Every numeric or status claim in public-facing markdown docs is mapped to its evidence from the machine-generated inventory. Claims that cannot be verified against the actual filesystem/registry are removed or corrected in public copy in this PR.

**Result codes:**
- ✅ VERIFIED — claim matches inventory
- ⚠️ CORRECTED — claim was wrong; corrected in this PR
- 🗑️ REMOVED — claim could not be verified; removed from public copy
- ℹ️ PRODUCT CLAIM — internal product description not verifiable from filesystem alone; retained if structurally reasonable
